cue: WHEN loop-family signals are extreme (recur_frac_max ≈ 1.0, high echo_best_score or dup_dense_last_frame) BUT a judgeable VLM verdict reports continuous=false / same_scene=false / scene_change at a seam, the clip is NOT a verbatim loop.
lesson: A true loop has no discontinuity — the VLM must confirm scene continuity at the recurring seam. If any scene_change verdict exists at the seam, reclassify as room_swap (inserted duplicate segment) rather than loop, even when recur/echo metrics alone would indicate looping.

cue: WHEN the fan assigns loop as top type primarily from recur_frac_max near 1.0 plus dup_dense_last_frame, but photo_jump_top3 shows a large z jump at a single boundary frame and the policy has not yet had that frame VLM-judged.
lesson: Treat a high-z photo jump at an unadjudicated boundary as blocking evidence against 'loop' and force a judge call on that boundary frame before concluding; a scene_change there demotes loop to room_swap.

cue: WHEN recur_frac_max is ~1.0 with huge echo/dup metrics and the model is about to conclude room_swap, but the duplicated segment's boundaries (the two seams bracketing the recurring block, e.g. two scenecut/iframe frames or large-z photo-jump clusters) have NOT both been VLM-judged — in particular when judge_calls = 0 or only the single scene_change seam has been judged.
lesson: ACTION + TYPING: a room_swap verdict survives arbitration only if BOTH seams of the swapped segment are judged discontinuous. Before concluding room_swap under verbatim-recurrence signals, spend judge calls on both boundary seams (the scene_change seam AND the second bracketing scenecut/large-z frame); conclude only after two seams report scene_change, otherwise type splice or withhold.

cue: WHEN recur_frac_max ≈ 1.0 and exactly ONE large-z photo jump (z > ~50) coincides with a single scenecut boundary, with all other judged seams reporting continuous/same_scene — i.e. one discontinuity, not two bracketing seams.
lesson: This is the loop's wrap-around seam, not an inserted segment: a verbatim loop with recur_frac_max ≈ 1.0 produces exactly one apparent scene change (the loop point), so type loop rather than room_swap unless a SECOND large-z boundary bracketing the recurring block is found. Keep typing loop even if the recurring seam's VLM verdict says scene_change.

cue: WHEN global loop-family signals are weak (recur_frac_max ≲ 0.4, echo_best_score ≲ 1) but a single extreme photo jump (z > ~50) sits at or next to a scenecut/iframe frame, and low-confidence candidates elsewhere are being judged while that frame remains unjudged.
lesson: ACTION: always prioritize judging the top-z photo-jump candidate before spending calls on low-evidence candidates — a scene_change verdict at an isolated extreme-z seam is sufficient evidence for splice even when recurrence metrics are flat; do not let judged 'none' verdicts on unrelated frames push corrupted confidence below the splice threshold.

cue: high recur_frac (~0.9+) AND dup_dense_last_frame is NULL/absent AND echo_best_score moderate (~1e3, well below verbatim 1e9+ scale) — reversed segments recur but are not pixel-identical and do not echo verbatim
lesson: Reverse segments are distinguished by the combination: high frame recurrence WITHOUT dense pixel duplicates and WITHOUT verbatim-scale echo. Reversed content recurs (recur_frac_max high, e.g. ~0.97) because frames appear again in reverse order, but reversed frames are not pixel-identical (dup_dense_last_frame stays NULL, unlike loops/room_swaps) and echo_best_score stays moderate (~1e3 vs 1e9+ for loops/room_swaps). When that trio holds — high recurrence + no dense dups + sub-verbatim echo — classify as reverse even if seams carry scene_change verdicts. Do NOT extend this to same-scene seams generally: a room_swap with same_scene=false persisting across a full segment is a swap, and a loop WILL set dup_dense_last_frame. The discriminator is the recurrence/dup/echo signature, not seam wording.
